# Presets

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-docs.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->

A preset is a named starting point. Set one with `"preset": "<name>"` in your config, with `auricFormatter.preset` in VS Code settings, or with `--preset <name>` on the CLI; then override whatever you disagree with. Options you do not mention keep the preset's value.

| Preset | Extends | Sets | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auric` | — | 50 options | The Auric house style: Prettier's layout plus the enhancements that made this formatter worth writing. |
| `prettier` | — | 281 options | Byte-compatible with Prettier 3 at its own defaults, with every Auric-only enhancement switched off. |
| `standard` | `prettier` | 14 options | StandardJS: no semicolons, single quotes, and a space before every function parameter list. |
| `google` | `prettier` | 18 options | The Google style guide: single quotes, tight object braces, and documentation blocks that are actually maintained. |
| `airbnb` | `prettier` | 19 options | The Airbnb style guide: single quotes, wider lines, grouped imports, and concise arrow bodies. |
| `compact` | `auric` | 35 options | Minimise vertical space: wider lines, collapsed collections, and no decorative blank lines. |
| `expanded` | `auric` | 28 options | Maximise readability and diff granularity: one item per line almost everywhere. |
| `legacy-tabs` | — | 25 options | Tabs, four columns, CRLF line endings and Allman braces, for codebases that were here first. |
| `minimal-diff` | — | 143 options | Change as little as possible: preserve the author's layout everywhere it is legal to do so. |
| `aligned` | `auric` | 29 options | Turn the column alignment engine on everywhere it is safe, for code that reads like a table. |
| `sorted` | `auric` | 30 options | Turn on every ordering rule the safety gate can verify, from import groups to stylesheet declarations. |
| `docs` | `auric` | 19 options | Tuned for prose: reflowed paragraphs, generated tables of contents and maintained documentation blocks. |
| `verified` | `auric` | 11 options | Run every safety check, re-format to prove idempotency, and fail the run rather than emit unverified output. |

## What each preset changes

### `auric`

The Auric house style: Prettier's layout plus the enhancements that made this formatter worth writing.

```json
{
  "preset": "auric",
  "alignTrailingComments": true,
  "alignmentBreakOnBlankLine": true,
  "alignmentMaxPadding": 24,
  "alignmentUseSpacesOnly": true,
  "atRuleBlankLine": true,
  "atRuleCase": "lower",
  "blankLineAfterDirectives": true,
  "blankLineAfterImports": "always",
  "blankLineBetweenMethods": "always",
  "blankLineBetweenRules": 1,
  "blockCommentStarAlign": true,
  "blockCommentStarPad": true,
  "collapseEmptyBlockBlankLines": true,
  "commentSpacing": "always",
  "endOfLine": "lf",
  "firstArgumentHugging": true,
  "hexCase": "lower",
  "insertFinalNewline": true,
  "jsdocAlign": true,
  "jsdocNormalizeTags": true,
  "jsdocTagOrder": ["@module","@description","@template","@typedef","@property","@param","@returns","@yields","@throws","@example","@remarks","@see","@link","@since","@version","@author","@deprecated","@internal"],
  "jsonPackageJsonOrder": true,
  "keyframeSelectorCase": "lower",
  "lastArgumentHugging": true,
  "maxBlankLinesAtEnd": 0,
  "maxBlankLinesAtStart": 0,
  "mdEmphasisMarker": "asterisk",
  "mdFormatCodeBlocks": true,
  "mdFrontmatterFormat": "format",
  "mdOrderedNumbering": "one",
  "mdStrongMarker": "asterisk",
  "mdTableAlign": true,
  "nestedRuleBlankLine": true,
  "objectWrap": "preserve",
  "preserveArrayFormatting": true,
  "preserveBannerComment": true,
  "preserveObjectShape": true,
  "printWidth": 100,
  "propertyCase": "lower",
  "safetyCommentPreservation": true
}
```

### `prettier`

Byte-compatible with Prettier 3 at its own defaults, with every Auric-only enhancement switched off.

```json
{
  "preset": "prettier",
  "abstractMemberBlankLine": false,
  "alignAssignments": "off",
  "alignConsecutiveDeclarations": false,
  "alignEnumValues": false,
  "alignImportSpecifiers": false,
  "alignObjectValues": false,
  "alignTernaryBranches": false,
  "alignTrailingComments": false,
  "alignTypeMembers": false,
  "arrayBracketSpacing": false,
  "arrayElementsPerLine": 0,
  "arrowBodyStyle": "preserve",
  "arrowChainBreak": "as-needed",
  "arrowParens": "always",
  "arrowReturnTypeSpacing": true,
  "assignmentLayout": "auto",
  "atRuleBlankLine": false,
  "atRuleCase": "preserve",
  "awaitParens": "as-needed",
  "bannerComment": "",
  "blankLineAfterComment": "preserve",
  "blankLineAfterDirectives": false,
  "blankLineAfterImports": "preserve",
  "blankLineBeforeComment": "preserve",
  "blankLineBeforeControlFlow": "preserve",
  "blankLineBeforeExport": "preserve",
  "blankLineBeforeReturn": "preserve",
  "blankLineBetweenMethods": "preserve",
  "blankLineBetweenRules": 0,
  "blankLineBetweenTopLevel": "preserve",
  "blockCommentStarAlign": true,
  "blockCommentStarPad": false,
  "bracketSameLine": false,
  "bracketSpacing": true,
  "breakBeforeBinaryOperators": false,
  "breakLongStrings": false,
  "byteOrderMark": "preserve",
  "catchPosition": "same-line",
  "chainedCallIndent": "indent",
  "chainedCallKeepFirstCall": true
}
```

### `standard`

StandardJS: no semicolons, single quotes, and a space before every function parameter list.

```json
{
  "preset": "standard",
  "arrowParens": "avoid",
  "commentSpacing": "always",
  "curlyBraces": "multi-line",
  "jsxSingleQuote": true,
  "objectWrap": "preserve",
  "printWidth": 80,
  "quoteProps": "as-needed",
  "semi": false,
  "semiColonBeforeIIFE": true,
  "singleQuote": true,
  "spaceAfterKeyword": true,
  "spaceBeforeBlocks": true,
  "spaceBeforeFunctionParen": "always",
  "trailingComma": "none"
}
```

### `google`

The Google style guide: single quotes, tight object braces, and documentation blocks that are actually maintained.

```json
{
  "preset": "google",
  "arrowParens": "always",
  "blankLineBetweenMethods": "always",
  "bracketSpacing": false,
  "commentSpacing": "always",
  "curlyBraces": "all",
  "hexCase": "lower",
  "htmlQuoteAttributes": "double",
  "jsdocNormalizeTags": true,
  "jsdocTagOrder": ["@module","@description","@template","@typedef","@property","@param","@returns","@yields","@throws","@example","@remarks","@see","@link","@since","@version","@author","@deprecated","@internal"],
  "jsdocWrap": "always",
  "printWidth": 80,
  "propertyCase": "lower",
  "quoteProps": "consistent",
  "semi": true,
  "singleQuote": true,
  "tabWidth": 2,
  "trailingComma": "all",
  "unitCase": "lower"
}
```

### `airbnb`

The Airbnb style guide: single quotes, wider lines, grouped imports, and concise arrow bodies.

```json
{
  "preset": "airbnb",
  "arrayBracketSpacing": false,
  "arrowBodyStyle": "as-needed",
  "arrowParens": "always",
  "blankLineAfterImports": "always",
  "bracketSpacing": true,
  "commentSpacing": "always",
  "importOrder": ["<BUILTIN_MODULES>","<THIRD_PARTY_MODULES>","^@/","^~/","^[.][.]/","^[.]/"],
  "importOrderCaseInsensitive": true,
  "importOrderSeparation": true,
  "importOrderSortSpecifiers": true,
  "maxBlankLines": 1,
  "objectWrap": "preserve",
  "printWidth": 100,
  "semi": true,
  "singleQuote": true,
  "sortImports": true,
  "spaceBeforeBlocks": true,
  "spaceInParens": false,
  "trailingComma": "all"
}
```

  "printWidth": 120,

### `legacy-tabs`

  "blockCommentStarAlign": true,
  "bracketSpacing": true,

  "printWidth": 120,

}

  "alignmentUseSpacesOnly": true,

  "graphqlFieldAlign": true,
  "gridTemplateAlign": true,
  "iniAlignValues": true,
  "jsdocAlign": true,
  "propertyValueAlign": true,
  "pythonAlignDictValues": true,
  "rustAlignMatchArms": true,
  "rustAlignStructFields": true,

  "universalAlignAssignments": true,
  "universalAlignConsecutive": true,
  "universalAlignTrailingComments": true,

### `sorted`

Turn on every ordering rule the safety gate can verify, from import groups to stylesheet declarations.

```json
{
  "preset": "sorted",
  "classMemberOrder": ["static-field","field","constructor","static-method","method","getter","setter"],
  "declarationOrder": "grouped",
  "exportOrder": "alphabetical",
  "graphqlSortDefinitions": true,
  "graphqlSortFields": true,
  "htmlSortAttributes": true,
  "importOrder": ["<BUILTIN_MODULES>","<THIRD_PARTY_MODULES>","^@/","^~/","^[.][.]/","^[.]/"],
  "importOrderCaseInsensitive": true,
  "importOrderGroupNamespaceSpecifiers": true,
  "importOrderSeparation": true,
  "importOrderSideEffectsFirst": true,
  "importOrderSortSpecifiers": true,
  "importOrderTypeImports": "last",
  "jsdocNormalizeTags": true,
  "jsdocTagOrder": ["@module","@description","@template","@typedef","@property","@param","@returns","@yields","@throws","@example","@remarks","@see","@link","@since","@version","@author","@deprecated","@internal"],
  "jsonPackageJsonOrder": true,
  "jsonSortKeys": true,
  "jsxSortProps": true,
  "sortCaseSensitivity": "insensitive",
  "sortClassMembers": true,
  "sortImports": true,
  "sortInterfaceMembers": true,
  "sortNaturalNumeric": true,
  "sortObjectKeys": true,
  "sortPreserveComments": true,
  "sortRespectBlankLineGroups": true,
  "sortUnionMembers": true,
  "tomlSortKeys": true,
  "xmlSortAttributes": true,
  "yamlKeySort": true
}
```

### `docs`

Tuned for prose: reflowed paragraphs, generated tables of contents and maintained documentation blocks.

```json
{
  "preset": "docs",
  "commentSpacing": "always",
  "commentWrap": "always",
  "commentWrapWidth": 80,
  "experimentalCommentReflow": true,
  "jsdocAlign": true,
  "jsdocBlankLineAfterDescription": true,
  "jsdocNormalizeTags": true,
  "jsdocTagOrder": ["@module","@description","@template","@typedef","@property","@param","@returns","@yields","@throws","@example","@remarks","@see","@link","@since","@version","@author","@deprecated","@internal"],
  "jsdocWrap": "always",
  "mdEscapeSpecial": true,
  "mdFormatCodeBlocks": true,
  "mdFrontmatterFormat": "format",
  "mdHeadingBlankLines": 1,
  "mdLinkStyle": "inline",
  "mdTableAlign": true,
  "mdTocGenerate": true,
  "mdTocMaxDepth": 3,
  "printWidth": 80,
  "proseWrap": "always"
}
```

### `verified`

Run every safety check, re-format to prove idempotency, and fail the run rather than emit unverified output.

```json
{
  "preset": "verified",
  "maxFileSizeKb": 8192,
  "parseTimeoutMs": 15000,
  "safetyCommentPreservation": true,
  "safetyIdempotency": true,
  "safetyIdempotencyPasses": 2,
  "safetyNumericLiterals": true,
  "safetyOnFailure": "throw",
  "safetyReparse": true,
  "safetyStringLiterals": true,
  "safetyTokenCheck": true,
  "safetyTokenCheckComments": true
}
```
